findings.evidence: proposal §3 makes the pluggable-seam contract (findings-schema-as-parameter, 同源-leg-as-callback) a Phase-A MUST; the plan originally split it across CSR-I3/CSR-I4 without an owning DoD.
findings.suggestion: CSR-I4 OWNS the pluggable seam — addressed: CSR-I4 scope + deliverables now expose findings-schema as a parameter + 同源 leg as a callback.

findings.evidence: proposal §7 requires a USER_GUIDE.md + bc/pd Scope Guard routing-hint doc-audit; the plan had no owning task/acceptance criterion.
findings.suggestion: Added a §10 cross-cutting doc-audit task + §6 acceptance criterion (anchored to proposal §7 rule 5).

findings.evidence: The plan restricted severity to {blocker, warning}, dropping bc's coverage severity (the reviewer's honest-disclosure mechanism, rule 3); the coverage-gap KIND is a defect, not the disclosure.
findings.suggestion: CSR-I1 preserves severity {blocker, warning, coverage}; coverage severity ≠ coverage-gap kind — addressed.

findings.evidence: The dogfood gate needs the 异源 leg (real API); no skip path for CI/no-token was defined.
findings.suggestion: Gate (1) skips gracefully when no API tokens; a recorded dogfood log substitutes — addressed.

findings.location: CSR-I4 DoD vs proposal §3 substantive-convergence (two prongs)

findings.suggestion: CSR-I4 DoD + CSR-I5 gate (3) now exercise BOTH prongs (a no-blocker-but-uncovered-core-claim fixture yields substantive_converged=false) — addressed.
